Select IC50 activity records against VEGFR2 (CHEMBL279) with publication provenance. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, docs on doc_id, and compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL279 and standard_type IC50. Require non-null canonical_smiles and non-null pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
